Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via the uninstallTemplate function allowing any authenticated user to gain administrative privileges by sending an AJAX request without nonce or checks
Arbitrary plugin deactivation and settings modification
Path traversal and local file inclusion
Information disclosure, modification, and denial of service
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Jupiter Theme and JupiterX Core plugins
Attack Vector: Authenticated user sending crafted AJAX requests exploiting uninstallTemplate function vulnerability
